issues.legal_issue: Whether the right to perform religious funeral rites includes a right to choose the place of burial.
Whether burial outside a place approved or designated under the applicable rules is permissible, including burial on private land.
Whether the State and Gram Panchayat must provide and designate burial places for members of religious communities.
Whether preventing burial in a village burial area previously used by members of the deceased’s religious community amounts to unconstitutional discrimination.

Whether the deceased’s body should be buried at the designated Christian burial ground or at the family’s preferred place, having regard to the applicable rules, public order, and the need for a dignified burial.
